rv.q: The all-company number “A Musical!” spells out the wonderful oddities of musical theater and the pure pleasure it can provide.
"SOMETHING ROTTEN!" is a great way to conclude another marvelous season.
Take it from a former Something Rotten skeptic and go find out for yourself.
For me, it was one of the most entertaining shows I’ve seen all season.
Something Rotten! delivers pure joy, and it’s something we could all use a little bit more of.
Lyric Stage’s production of Something Rotten! is an ode to the original, bringing a few bits of unique flair while delivering the chaotic hilarity audiences know and love.
A good time can be its own justification, and that’s the case here.

cn.t: Critics hail this production as a triumphant musical comedy that fully embraces the show's rowdy, pun-laden humor with exuberant performances and strong vocals, though success hinges on the director's commitment to its anything-for-a-laugh spirit.
